headers.access-control-allow-methods: POST, GET, OPTIONS, DELETE, PUT, PATCH, HEAD
headers.access-control-allow-headers: Authorization, Content-Type, X-Requested-With, Upload-Length, Upload-Offset, Tus-Resumable, Upload-Metadata, Upload-Defer-Length, Upload-Concat
headers.access-control-expose-headers: Upload-Offset, Location, Upload-Length, Tus-Version, Tus-Resumable, Tus-Max-Size, Tus-Extension, Upload-Metadata
